records.question: What was emissions intensity per parcel in 2025 and what level would the 30% reduction target from the 2023 baseline imply?
records.expected_answer: 2.40 g CO2e per parcel in 2025; 2023 was 2.71 so the target is about 1.90

answer.answer: Emissions intensity in 2025 was 2.40 g CO2e per parcel. The 2023 baseline was 2.71 g CO2e per parcel; a 30% reduction implies 2.71 × 0.70 = 1.897 ≈ 1.90 g CO2e per parcel by 2030. As of 2025, intensity has fallen to 2.40, i.e. a reduction of (2.71 − 2.40) / 2.71 ≈ 11.4% versus the baseline.

citations.quote: Our target is a 30% reduction in emissions intensity per parcel by 2030, measured against the 2023 baseline.

answer.judge_reason: Matches the reference: 2.40 g CO2e per parcel in 2025 and ~1.90 g CO2e per parcel implied by a 30% cut from the 2.71 baseline.
